S0432.reason: After Bennett, English courts have a discretion to stay for abuse of process where extradition was bypassed, but they exercise that discretion only exceptionally.

S0598.reason: Under VCLT Article 19(c), a reservation is impermissible when it is incompatible with the treaty’s object and purpose.

S0272.reason: SDS denatures proteins and gives a uniform charge-to-mass ratio so the gel separates polypeptides by chain length alone; it does not add a positive charge or break the primary structure into fragments.
